  s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 64))) ∧ s.assumed = #[] ∧
  ∃ i : BitVec 64, env[1]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧ -1 ≤ i.toInt ∧ i.toInt < len.toInt

def hdInner (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (env : Env Val) (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 21 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice ref 0 len len) ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 len) ∧
  s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 64))) ∧ s.assumed = #[] ∧
  ∃ i j : BitVec 64, env[6]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧ env[2]? = some (.int 64 j) ∧

def bsMax (ys : List (BitVec 64)) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ k (hk : k < ys.length) (hl : l < ys.length), k ≤ l → ys[k].toInt ≤ ys[l].toInt

theorem bsMax_zero (ys : List (BitVec 64)) : bsMax ys 0 := by
  intro k hk hl h
  have : k = 0 := by omega
  subst this; exact Int.le_refl _

theorem bsMax_noswap {ys : List (BitVec 64)} {j : Nat} (hj : j + 1 < ys.length) (hm : bsMax ys j)
    (hle : (ys[j]'(by omega)).toInt ≤ (ys[j+1]'hj).toInt) : bsMax ys (j + 1) := by
  intro k hk hl hkl
  by_cases h : k = j + 1
  · subst h; exact Int.le_refl _
  · exact Int.le_trans (hm k hk (by omega) (by omega)) hle

theorem bsGood_exit {ys : List (BitVec 64)} {j : Nat} {c : Int} (hg : bsGood ys c) (hm : bsMax ys j)

  intro a b ha hb hab hcb
  by_cases h : c ≤ (b : Int)
  · exact hg a b ha hb hab h
  · have : b = j := by omega
    subst this
    exact hm a ha hb (by omega)

def bs4Inv (len : BitVec 64) (ref : Nat) (ys : List (BitVec 64)) (env : Env Val) (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 16 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice ref 0 len len) ∧ s.assumed = #[] ∧
  s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64))) ∧
  ∃ i : BitVec 64, env[1]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧ 1 ≤ i.toInt ∧ i.toInt ≤ max len.toInt 1

theorem bs4_step {orc : Oracle} {hv : Havoc Val} (ys : List (BitVec 64)) (len : BitVec 64) (ref : Nat) (hlen : len.toInt = ys.length)
    (href : ref ≠ 0) (hg : bsGood ys 0) :
    ∀ n env s, bs4Inv len ref ys env s →
      (∀ env' s', bs4Inv len ref ys env' s' → wpPtN prog orc hv n ⟨4, 1⟩ (fun r s'' => r = .bool true ∧ s''.assumed = #[]) env' s') →
      wpPtN prog orc hv (n + 1) ⟨4, 1⟩ (fun r s'' => r = .bool true ∧ s''.assumed = #[]) env s := by
  have hL : len.toInt < 2 ^ 63 := by have := @BitVec.toInt_lt 64 len; simpa using this
  intro n env s hI ih
  obtain ⟨hsz, h0, ha, hh, i, h1, hi1, hi2⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨_, e0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h0
  obtain ⟨_, e1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h1
  apply wpPtN_of_block prog_f4 rfl
  wp_simp [f4]
  simp [e0, e1, hsz]
  cases hc : i.slt len
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hc
    dsimp only
    wp_step prog_f4 [f4] as n
    simp [hsz, ha]
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    dsimp only
    have hi1' : (i - 1#64).toInt = i.toInt - 1 := by
      rw [BitVec.toInt_sub_of_not_ssubOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.ssubOverflow] <;> omega
    have hin1 : ((i - 1#64).toNat : Int) = (i - 1#64).toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg (by omega)
    have hin : (i.toNat : Int) = i.toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg (by omega)
    have hiu : i.ult len = true := ult_of_toInt (by omega) hc
    have hiu1 : (i - 1#64).ult len = true := ult_of_toInt (by omega) (by omega)
    have hk : (18446744073709551615 + i.toNat) % 18446744073709551616 = i.toNat - 1 := by
      have := i.isLt; omega
    have hk2 : (i - 1#64).toNat = i.toNat - 1 := by omega
    have hl1 := heapLoad_arr (k := i.toNat - 1) href hh (by simp; omega)
    have hl2 := heapLoad_arr (k := i.toNat) href hh (by simp; omega)
    wp_step prog_f4 [f4] as n
    simp [e0, e1, hsz, dp_indexAddr hiu, dp_indexAddr hiu1, hk, hl1, hl2]
    have hgs : (ys[i.toNat]'(by omega)).slt (ys[i.toNat - 1]'(by omega)) = false := by
      simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt]

    simp [hgs]
    wp_step prog_f4 [f4] as n
    simp [hsz, e1]
    have hi1'' : (i + 1#64).toInt = i.toInt + 1 := by
      rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
    refine wpPtN_le (show _ ≤ n + 1 + 1 by omega) (ih _ _ ?_)
    refine ⟨by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz, e0], ha, hh, i + 1#64, by simp [hsz], by omega, by omega⟩

theorem bs4_true {orc : Oracle} {hv : Havoc Val} (ys : List (BitVec 64)) (len : BitVec 64) (ref : Nat)
    (hlen : len.toInt = ys.length) (href : ref ≠ 0) (hg : bsGood ys 0) (s : HState Val)

def bsOuter (len : BitVec 64) (ref N : Nat) (env : Env Val) (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 35 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice ref 0 len len) ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 len) ∧ s.assumed = #[] ∧

    ys.length = N ∧ env[1]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧ 0 ≤ i.toInt ∧ i.toInt ≤ len.toInt ∧

def bsInner (len : BitVec 64) (ref N : Nat) (i : BitVec 64) (env : Env Val) (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 35 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice ref 0 len len) ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 len) ∧ s.assumed = #[] ∧

  fun _ s' => s'.assumed = #[] ∧ ∃ ys : List (BitVec 64), s'.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64))) ∧
    ys.length = N ∧ bsGood ys 0

theorem bs_leave {orc : Oracle} {hv : Havoc Val} (N : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (ref : Nat) (hlen : len.toInt = N)
    (n : Nat) (ih : ∀ env' s', bsOuter len ref N env' s' → wpPtN prog orc hv n ⟨0, 1⟩ (bsPost ref N) env' s')

  simp [g1, hsz]

    rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega

  refine ⟨by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz]; exact (Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp k0).2,
    by simp [hsz]; exact (Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp k3).2, ha, zs, i + 1#64, kh, kl, by simp [hsz],
    by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [hi1']
  have : len.toInt - (i.toInt + 1) = len.toInt - i.toInt - 1 := by omega

theorem bs_inner {orc : Oracle} {hv : Havoc Val} (N : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (ref : Nat) (hlen : len.toInt = N)
    (href : ref ≠ 0)
    (n : Nat) (ih : ∀ env' s', bsOuter len ref N env' s' → wpPtN prog orc hv n ⟨0, 1⟩ (bsPost ref N) env' s')
    (i : BitVec 64) :
    ∀ M, M ≤ n → ∀ env s, bsInner len ref N i env s → wpPtN prog orc hv M ⟨0, 4⟩ (bsPost ref N) env s := by

  | ind M ihm =>
  intro hMn env s hJ

  obtain ⟨_, g0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp j0
  obtain ⟨_, g1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp j1
  obtain ⟨_, g2⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp j2
  obtain ⟨_, g3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp j3
  have hjn : (j.toNat : Int) = j.toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg hj0
  have hj1i : (j + 1#64).toInt = j.toInt + 1 := by
    rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
  have hli : (len - i).toInt = len.toInt - i.toInt := by
    rw [BitVec.toInt_sub_of_not_ssubOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.ssubOverflow] <;> omega
  have hjn1 : (j + 1#64).toNat = j.toNat + 1 := by
    have := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg (i := j + 1#64) (by omega); omega
  wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as M1
  simp [g0, g1, g2, g3, jsz]
  cases hj : (j + 1#64).slt (len - i)
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hj
    dsimp only
    cases M1 with
    | zero => exact wpPtN_zero prog_f0
    | succ M2 =>
      exact leave M2 (by omega) _ _ zs (by simp [jsz]) (by simp [jsz, g0]) (by simp [jsz, g1])
        (by simp [jsz, g3]) ja jh jl (bsGood_exit jg jm (by omega))
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hj
    dsimp only
    have hzl : j.toNat + 1 < zs.length := by omega
    have hju : j.ult len = true := ult_of_toInt hj0 (by omega)
    have hj1u : (j + 1#64).ult len = true := ult_of_toInt (by omega) (by omega)
    have hk : (j.toNat + 1) % 18446744073709551616 = j.toNat + 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by have := j.isLt; omega)
    have l0 := heapLoad_arr (k := j.toNat) href jh (by simpa using (by omega : j.toNat < zs.length))
    have l1 := heapLoad_arr (k := j.toNat + 1) href jh (by simpa using hzl)
    wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as M2
    simp [jsz, g0, g2, dp_indexAddr hju, dp_indexAddr hj1u, hk, l0, l1]
    cases hgt : (zs[j.toNat + 1]'hzl).slt (zs[j.toNat]'(by omega))
    · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hgt
      dsimp only
      wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as M3
      simp [jsz, g2]
      apply ihm M3 (by omega) (by omega)
      refine ⟨by simp [jsz], by simp [jsz, g0], by simp [jsz, g3], ja, by simp [jsz, g1], hi0, hi1, zs, j + 1#64, jh, jl,
        by simp [jsz], by omega, by omega, jg, ?_⟩
      rw [hjn1]
      exact bsMax_noswap hzl jm hgt
    · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hgt
      dsimp only
      have st1 := heapStore_arr (r := ref) (k := j.toNat) href jh
        (by simpa using (by omega : j.toNat < zs.length)) (.int 64 zs[j.toNat + 1])
      have jh1 : (s.heap.setIfInBounds ref (.arr ((zs.map (.int 64)).set j.toNat
          (.int 64 zs[j.toNat + 1]))))[ref]? =
          some (.arr ((zs.map (.int 64)).set j.toNat (.int 64 zs[j.toNat + 1]))) := by
        simp [Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds]
        exact (Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp jh).1
      have st2 := heapStore_arr (r := ref) (k := j.toNat + 1) href jh1
        (by simpa using hzl) (.int 64 zs[j.toNat])
      wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as M3

      refine ⟨by simp [jsz], by simp [jsz, g0], by simp [jsz, g3], ja, by simp [jsz, g1], hi0, hi1,
        (zs.set j.toNat (zs[j.toNat + 1]'hzl)).set (j.toNat + 1) (zs[j.toNat]'(by omega)), j + 1#64, ?_, ?_,
        by simp [jsz], by omega, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [List.map_set, Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds]
        exact (Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp jh).1
      · simp [jl]
      · exact bsGood_swap hzl (by omega) jg
      · rw [hjn1]
        exact bsMax_swap hzl jm hgt

theorem bs_step {orc : Oracle} {hv : Havoc Val} (N : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (ref : Nat) (hlen : len.toInt = N)
    (href : ref ≠ 0) :
    ∀ n env s, bsOuter len ref N env s →
      (∀ env' s', bsOuter len ref N env' s' → wpPtN prog orc hv n ⟨0, 1⟩ (bsPost ref N) env' s') →
      wpPtN prog orc hv (n + 1) ⟨0, 1⟩ (bsPost ref N) env s := by
  have hL : len.toInt < 2 ^ 63 := by have := @BitVec.toInt_lt 64 len; simpa using this
  intro n env s hI ih
  obtain ⟨hsz, h0, h3, ha, ys, i, hh, hyl, h1, hi0, hi1, hg⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨_, e0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h0
  obtain ⟨_, e1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h1
  obtain ⟨_, e3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h3
  apply wpPtN_of_block prog_f0 rfl
  wp_simp [f0]
  simp [e1, e3, hsz]
  cases hc : i.slt len
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hc
    dsimp only
    wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
    have : len.toInt - i.toInt = 0 := by omega
    rw [this] at hg
    simp [bsPost, ha]
    exact ⟨ys, hh, hyl, hg⟩
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    dsimp only
    wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as n
    refine bs_inner N len ref hlen href _ ih i _ (Nat.le_succ _) _ _ ?_
    refine ⟨by simp [hsz], by simp [hsz, e0], by simp [hsz, e3], ha, by simp [hsz, e1], hi0, hc, ys, 0#64, hh, hyl,

theorem bs_main {orc : Oracle} {hv : Havoc Val} (a : List (BitVec 64)) (a_len : BitVec 64) (a_ref : Nat) (s : HState Val)
    (h_a_len : a_len.toInt = a.length) (h_a_ref : a_ref ≠ 0) (h_a : s.heap[a_ref]? = some (.arr (a.map (.int 64)))) (h_assumed : s.assumed = #[]) :
    wpFun prog orc hv 0 [.slice a_ref 0 a_len a_len] (bsPost a_ref a.length) s := by
  apply wpFun_of_wpPt prog_f0
  apply wpPt_of_block prog_f0 rfl
  intro k
  wp_simp [f0]
  apply wpPtN_of_wpPt
  apply wpPt_loop prog_f0 (bsOuter a_len a_ref a.length) (bs_step a.length a_len a_ref h_a_len h_a_ref)
  refine ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp, h_assumed, a, 0#64, h_a, rfl, by simp, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp; omega
  · intro x y hx hy hxy hc
    simp at hc; omega
proof:
refine wpFun_mono (Q := bsPost a_ref a.length) (fun v s' h => ?_) (bs_main a a_len a_ref s h_a_len h_a_ref h_a h_assumed)
  obtain ⟨ha, ys, hh, hl, hg⟩ := h
  exact ⟨ha, bs4_true ys a_len a_ref (by omega) h_a_ref hg s' ha hh⟩

      refine ⟨by simp [jsz], by simpa [jsz] using j0, by simpa [jsz] using j3, by simpa [jsz] using j1, hi0, hin,
        ha, zs, j + 1#64, jh, jp, by simp [jsz], by omega, by omega⟩
    · dsimp only
      have st1 := heapStore_arr (r := ref) (k := j.toNat) hr jh (by simpa using hjx) (.int 64 zs[k1])
      have jh1 : (s.heap.setIfInBounds ref (.arr ((zs.map (.int 64)).set j.toNat
          (.int 64 zs[k1]))))[ref]? =
          some (.arr ((zs.map (.int 64)).set j.toNat (.int 64 zs[k1]))) := by
        simp [Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds]
        exact (Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp jh).1
      have st2 := heapStore_arr (r := ref) (k := k1) hr jh1 (by simpa using hk1x) (.int 64 zs[j.toNat])
      wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as M3
      simp [e0, e2, e3, jsz, dp_indexAddr hju, dp_indexAddr hj1u, lj, lj1, hk1, st1, st2]
      wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as M4
      simp [e2, jsz]
      apply ihm M4 (by omega) (by omega)
      refine ⟨by simp [jsz], by simpa [jsz] using j0, by simpa [jsz] using j3, by simpa [jsz] using j1, hi0, hin,
        ha, (zs.set j.toNat zs[k1]).set k1 zs[j.toNat], j + 1#64, ?_, ?_, by simp [jsz], by omega, by omega⟩
      · simp [List.map_set, Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds]
        exact (Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp jh).1
      · exact (List.set_set_perm hjx hk1x).trans jp

theorem pm_step {orc : Oracle} {hv : Havoc Val} (a : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64)
    (hlen : len.toInt = a.length) (hr : ref ≠ 0) :
    ∀ n env s, pmOuter a ref len env s →
      (∀ env' s', pmOuter a ref len env' s' → wpPtN prog orc hv n ⟨0, 1⟩ (pmPost a ref) env' s') →
      wpPtN prog orc hv (n + 1) ⟨0, 1⟩ (pmPost a ref) env s := by
  have hL : len.toInt < 2 ^ 63 := by have := @BitVec.toInt_lt 64 len; simpa using this
  intro n env s hI ih
  obtain ⟨hsz, h0, h3, ha, ys, i, hh, hp, h1, hi0, hi1⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨_, e0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h0
  obtain ⟨_, e1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h1
  obtain ⟨_, e3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h3
  apply wpPtN_of_block prog_f0 rfl
  wp_simp [f0]
  simp [e1, e3, hsz]
  cases hc : i.slt len
  · dsimp only
    wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as m
    exact ⟨ha, ys, hh, hp⟩
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    dsimp only
    wp_step prog_f0 [f0] as m
    apply pm_inner a ref len hlen hr i hi0 hc (m + 1) ih m (by omega)
    refine ⟨by simp [hsz], by simpa [hsz] using h0, by simpa [hsz] using h3, by simpa [hsz] using h1, hi0, hc,
      ha, ys, 0#64, hh, hp, by simp [hsz], by simp, by simp; omega⟩
proof:
apply wpFun_of_wpPt prog_f0
  apply wpPt_of_block prog_f0 rfl
  intro k
  wp_simp [f0]
  apply wpPtN_of_wpPt
  apply wpPt_loop prog_f0 (pmOuter a a_ref a_len) (pm_step a a_ref a_len h_a_len h_a_ref)
  refine ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp, h_assumed, a, 0#64, h_a, List.Perm.refl _, by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
  simp; omega
